deal_summary: Meridian Optics Group needs freight moved from Memphis to Nashville – 22 shipments per month, each with five pallets (≈200 kg per pallet) that must be sorted and segregated by store on delivery – and from Columbus to Indianapolis – six shipments per month, each with three pallets, delivering to a limited‑access hospital campus.

lanes.rationale: We quoted LTL Standard because a five‑pallet shipment fits comfortably within LTL capacity, offering a cost‑effective rate while allowing us to apply the required SORT_SEGREGATE accessorial for store‑by‑store delivery.
LTL Standard is also appropriate for the three‑pallet shipments, and the LIMITED_ACCESS accessorial covers the extra handling needed for the hospital campus delivery.

assumptions: Each shipment will consistently contain the stated number of pallets (5 for Memphis‑Nashville, 3 for Columbus‑Indianapolis).
The weight per pallet remains at 200 kg (≈440 lb) for all shipments.
Both origin facilities have standard dock doors and operate during normal business hours.
The SORT_SEGREGATE charge is applied per pallet at the Nashville destination as indicated in the proposal.
The LIMITED_ACCESS charge applies to every Indianapolis delivery due to the hospital campus restrictions.
open_questions: Does the competitor’s $410 per shipment quote for the Memphis lane include the sort‑and‑segregate service, or is that an additional charge?
Are there any lift‑gate, residential, or inside‑delivery requirements at either origin or destination that we haven’t captured?
Can you confirm the exact dock hours and any appointment windows required at the Memphis and Columbus origins?
Will the weight per pallet ever vary from the 200 kg baseline, affecting the LTL pricing?
What are your preferred billing and payment terms for the monthly invoice?
